prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is nearby, then take it, process and store it. Otherwise, approach and scan object. Do specific task. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Action ID = MoveToObjectStorage    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = ProcessObject    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />     <Action ID = TakeObject    />     <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />     <Action ID = MoveToObjectStorage    />     <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> </Sequence> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />     <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> </Sequence> <Fallback>     <Sequence>         <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />         <Action ID = TakeObject    />         <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />                        <Action ID = MoveToObjectStorage    />         <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />      </Sequence>     <Sequence>         <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />         <Action ID = ApproachObject    />     </Sequence>     <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />     <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> </Fallback>"
code:
SELECTOR
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
				DO TakeObject
		ELSE
			DO ProcessObject
			DO MoveToObjectStorage
			DO CheckObjectProperties
		END
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
				DO ApproachObject
		END
		DO ScanAreaForObject
		DO SpecificTask
	END
